accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Why is there a box behind the 3D printer, and why did you just put your entire body between me and it?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I'm not blocking it. I'm standing near it with unusual commitment.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: You called me over urgently. Normally that means something in the workshop requires investigating.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Correct. I need you to investigate literally anything else for, say, ten minutes.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: That is not how urgency works. Is the box part of an experiment?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Potentially. It may be a very interesting experiment. Or it may be a cardboard reminder that I should have worked out more details before starting.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: So you do not know what it will do.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I know enough to be curious and not enough to be relaxed. That's a respectable scientific neighborhood.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I tested the idea of testing it. The idea was enthusiastic.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Then we begin with the obvious question: what are we trying to find out?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Whether opening that box creates a useful prototype, a workshop problem, or the most honest video I've made all week.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: That is three possible outcomes, not a question.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I see. The experiment has already produced a result.
